items.title: Jack DeJohnette — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: Chuck Mangione! Chuck Mangione was playing trumpet. Frank Mitchell was playing tenor saxophone and Keith was playing piano on a song called "Buttercorn Lady.” Charles asked me about a pianist, and Charles had heard Keith in Boston and so we both said "Oh! Keith, let's get Keith!" Then Reggie didn't work out so I'd been playing with Cecil so I suggested Cecil McBee, and then the Charles Lloyd Quartet was formed. So I was still doing some freelancing around New York. I got a chance to play with McCoy and Joe…
Not Bob, Bob still plays though… …it'll come to me. Anyway.
